findings.statement: The evidence supports a four-way causal taxonomy rather than a single repeated-bug story. Proximate scientific defects are route-specific: Fort lower-node interpolation and later null-oracle pathology; D-027 non-adjoint target-leg deposition; D-028 native conditioning/covariance; D-029 theorem-to-selector discontinuity; and B3-v2/W7 executable shell, basis, tail, trace, and arithmetic-graph incompleteness. Recurring process amplifiers are architecture-before-closed-invariants, last-defect packetization, additive truth surfaces, and late cheap negative controls. Bounded passes remain valid within their stated domains. Harness/reroot drift is a process and auditability cause but is not supported as the scientific cause of the post-repair D-037 failures.
